blocks.heading: The ATLAS ISME x Northeastern University Global Business Pathway
text: The Global Business Pathway is a globally integrated academic progression model developed in partnership with Northeastern University. Students begin their undergraduate journey at ATLAS ISME and seamlessly progress to Northeastern University London, where they

text.strong: complete their degree and graduate with a UK-accredited business qualification awarded by Northeastern University London.

text: Graduates will also be able to transition to a
at any of the Northeastern Universities campuses located in the

text.strong: USA Boston, Miami, or Oakland (USA) or stay back in London for an MSc.

text: Designed to meet international academic and industry benchmarks, the pathway ensures curriculum continuity, applied learning, and global readiness for careers and advanced study.

blocks.heading: How This Global Business Pathway Works

p.strong: Complete the first two years of your Undergraduate Business program at ATLAS ISME, building strong foundations in:

list: Deep understanding your choice of Business function:Marketing, Finance, Economics,Artificial Intelligence, Business Psychology, and more

p.strong: Transfer to Northeastern University London and earn a fully UK-accredited BSc (Hons) in Business.

list: Exposure to global industry and networks

p.strong: Advance to postgraduate study with two global options:

list: STEM-designated 1-year MSc at a Northeastern University campus in the USA “Boston, Miami, or Oakland”
1-year Master’s degree at Northeastern University London
18+ months of post-study work in the UK (Graduate Visa)
Up to 36 months of post-study work in the USA (OPT for STEM programs)

body.p: Visa and post-study work rights are subject to prevailing immigration regulations at the time of graduation

blocks.title: About Northeastern University London
blocks.text: Set in London’s dynamic centre, our state-of-the-art campus offers a vibrant and supportive place to study. Our modern facilities next to the Tower of London and Tower Bridge, and on the edge of the capital’s financial district, place you at the epicentre of global finance, technology, business and culture. With small class sizes of typically less than 40 students, you’ll benefit from high levels of support and interaction with staff. You’ll join a thriving, collaborative and global community that spans continents, with students and staff from almost 100 nationalities.

blocks.label: Disclaimer:
blocks.text: ATLAS SkillTech University does not award foreign degrees and facilitates only the academic pathway and preparatory components. All foreign degree programmes, accreditations, rankings, scholarships, visa outcomes, post-study work rights, and progression opportunities are governed solely by the policies of Northeastern University / Northeastern University London and applicable regulatory authorities, and ATLAS SkillTech University does not guarantee any such outcomes. This is not a dual, joint, or twinning degree programme; each stage is awarded independently by Northeastern University / Northeastern University London, and progression to further studies is optional and subject to Northeastern University / Northeastern University London admission criteria, policies, and independent evaluation. Tuition fees are determined by Northeastern University / Northeastern University London and may be revised at their discretion. Terms and conditions apply.
